name: StdRequestBot
description: High-performance Telegram Automated Join Request Approver and Lead-Gen Funnel Bot built in Go with MongoDB persistence and the DM-First protocol.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram Numeric User ID of the Bot Owner

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel username to force users to join before accessing dashboard (without @)

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel ID for audit logs (optional, e.g. -1001234567890)

APPROVAL_DELAY_SECONDS.description: Delay in seconds before approving join request (0 for instant)
